subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses present and past tenses correctly

show.line: Today I jump. Yesterday I jumped. When it already happened, the word changes. Jump, jumped. Play, played!

rounds.prompt: Yesterday I, gap, with my ball. Which word fits?
Today I, gap, to school. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Walk! Today I walk to school.

rounds.prompt: Today I jump. Yesterday I, what? Say the word.

rounds.praise: Yes! Cooked means it already happened.

rounds.prompt: Today Mama cooks. Yesterday Mama, what? Say the word.
Now, or already happened? Put each word in its group.

hints: Yesterday means it already happened. Add the ending. Jump, jumped.
Today means now. Keep the word short. Jump.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Yesterday I, gap, my dog.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Yesterday has already happened. Yesterday I washed my dog.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Yesterday I washed my dog!

parent_line: Can choose the right word for now and for something that already happened.
